selection_policy.scope: every non-empty legacy player track in every scene under the existing training dataset
selection_policy.player_prompts: for every labeled frame, use the legacy full-frame xyxy player bbox with the SAM3.1 tennis player text prompt, then refine the selected mask with an interior positive point
selection_policy.racket_prompts: for every labeled racket frame, use the legacy racket_bbox_crop translated to full-frame xyxy with the SAM3.1 tennis racket text prompt, then refine with the mean of the four legacy racket_mask_points as a positive click when available
selection_policy.racket_drift_correction: when the initial SAM mask center falls outside the legacy racket box and is separated from the guided positive click, add a negative click at the drifting mask center
selection_policy.frame_positions: all distinct frame_id values present in legacy per-track metadata; prompt each player and racket independently on every labeled frame
selection_policy.sequence_partition: 48-frame chunks on the source frame grid; use per-frame box and point prompts, save the selected target mask immediately, and do not rely on video propagation
selection_policy.source_alignment: compare opaque legacy crop pixels against the source frame at the stored player bbox; fail if mean absolute RGB error exceeds 2.0

quality_policy.player_selection_motion_signal: rank valid tracks using camera-compensated centroid motion, pose support, SAM confidence, shape and persistence
quality_policy.uncertain_observations: record in quality audit and exclude from training export

training_export.accepted_masks: lossless PNG sidecars under segmentation_masks; sample records link each accepted mask and checksum

promotion.reason: SAM3.1 pseudo-labels with conservative automatic gates still require visual/manual review before promotion
